verdict.rationale: Docs confirm cloud object-storage integration (S3, GCS, Azure) with secrets management and general data-loading guidance, implying DuckDB-style single-command ingestion, but no evidence pack item shows an explicit documented command or example loading CSV, JSON, and Parquet specifically from cloud storage in one step. Missing for 10: explicit command syntax/examples (e.g. read_csv/read_json/read_parquet from s3://) and confirmation these formats are all supported via one unified command.
